description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Zone' model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class manages CRUD operations and data retrieval for geographical zone entities in the system, including adding, editing, deleting, and fetching zones and their descriptions, with cache management integration.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: This class handles database operations related to geographical zones in the OpenCart system, including creation, update, deletion, retrieval of zones and their descriptions, and cache management.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Creates a new zone record in the database, adds descriptions for the zone in different languages, and clears the zone cache.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Updates an existing zone record and its descriptions, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes a zone record and its descriptions from the database, then clears the cache.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific zone record along with description data for the current language.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zones with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all zones associated with a specific country, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of zones, with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total count of zones for a specific country.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a zone in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a given zone.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all zone descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches the description for a zone in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given zone.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns all zone descriptions for a specific language.
